'''The Tipsy Gelding''' is an inn located in the village of [[Hinderstap]] [[Murandy]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Tipsy Gelding, The|TG}}  The inn is three streets out from the center of town in the back west corner of the village.{{ref||TG}}  In the opinion of [[Matrim Cauthon|Mat Cauthon]], the establishment is more of a tavern than an inn.{{ref||TG}}

The night when [[Mat]], [[Thom]], [[Joline]], [[Teslyn]] and [[Edesina]] are sleeping in Hinderstap, they are attacked inside this inn by the crazy people of the village.
